findings.title: Tight schedule against the deadline
findings.detail: The chain of tasks adds up to 20 days (booking 2, stallholders 10, floor plan 3, furniture 2, rota 3), leaving no slack before the 21-day deadline. Any delay in confirming stallholders would push the market date.
findings.quote: The market is on a Saturday, 21 days after our kickoff meeting, and everything in the task list below needs to be finished by then.

findings.title: Hall booking depends on go-ahead not in the plan
findings.detail: Joan will book the rooms only once the Council gives the go-ahead, but no task or date covers that approval. The whole schedule rests on it, and the office can hold the date only for a few days.
findings.quote: Joan will book the main hall and the side room through the Town Hall office as soon as we have the go-ahead.

findings.title: No task for the children's corner
findings.detail: The summary describes a children's corner with colouring and a book swap, and the floor plan must show it, but no task covers organising it or the volunteers for it.
findings.quote: a small children's corner with colouring and a book swap

findings.title: Pitch fees and float handling not scheduled
findings.detail: Martin will take pitch fees and Joan will sort out the float, but neither is a task with a duration. Money handling should be planned and assigned before the day.

findings.title: On-the-day setup and clear-up not in the task list
findings.detail: Stallholders arrive at 8am and the rooms must be cleared and tables stacked by 5pm, but no task covers setting up or clearing away, or who does it.
findings.quote: The caretaker locks up at 5pm, by which time the rooms will be cleared and the tables stacked.
